messages:
Rae: Quick micro-sprint triage  post-launch: streaming responses are leaking memory for a subset of long sessions. Need to decide between a quick mitigation or shipping the small UX/billing fixes we already scoped.
Owen: We started seeing OOMs on v3.1 when streams exceed ~10k tokens, usually long multi-turn sessions from a couple enterprise tenants. Heap profiles attached to the ticket.
Vik: Two paths: 1) emergency close-on-idle patch + backpressure (est ~0.5d, low risk) OR 2) rework streaming runtime to better reclaim chunks (est ~10d, safer long-term).
PM-Juno: Affected customers are on paid plans and saw session drops that triggered retries/billing noise. Short-term mitigation preferred so they don't lose confidence.
Design-Terra: UX polishes waiting in the queue: message spacing fix (2h), typing indicator timing (3h), billing invoice label tweak (1h). All small and would improve immediate sentiment.
QA-Meg: For mitigation, acceptance: no OOMs for the repro corpus during a 24h canary, p99 mem <= baseline +10%, and new unit/integration tests covering stream closing. I'll add the replay harness.
Rae: Can we do mitigation + ship the two shortest UX fixes in the same micro-sprint? That seems reasonable if the mitigation is quick.
Vik: Yes. Patch plan: add explicit idle-close and backpressure threshold, add a defensive guard in the serializer. Branch: `hotfix/stream-close-1960`. PR WIP: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/1987
Owen: If we take the patch route, let's also add a regression test using the actual customer session that reproduced it. Will attach sanitized trace to the test.
PM-Juno: I'll prepare customer comms stating mitigation underway and that a runtime rework is scheduled as a follow-on epic. Also will add a short note in the status page if we need a brief maintenance window.
Design-Terra: If you take the two UX fixes (spacing + invoice label) now, I'll review quickly and sign off. Helps customer perception while we monitor.
QA-Meg: Once PR lands to canary, I'll run the replay and the memory profile job. Need 24h observation window.
Vik: ETA: patch PR in ~18h, QA run next 12h, canary rollout after approvals. Runtime rewrite to be added as epic `streaming-runtime-rewrite`, estimate 8d and owner Vik. Label: "follow-on:rewrite".
SRE-bot: Canary window requested: 2025-06-05T03:00Z for service "streaming-proxy". Rollback threshold: 0.25% error or memory spike >15%. Monitoring hooks enabled.
Owen: I'll update the backlog: move the three small UX tickets into current sprint (two to ship now, one to queue), attach the repro traces to the hotfix ticket, and create the rewrite epic.
Rae: Decision recap: ship emergency close-on-idle + backpressure patch (owner Vik) -> canary -> 24h monitor. Ship message-spacing and invoice-label polishes in this micro-sprint (owner Design-Terra). Schedule full streaming runtime rewrite as follow-on epic (owner Vik, est 8d). PM-Juno handles customer comms.
QA-Meg: Smoke tests in canary passed after first validation. Starting 24h job.
QA-Meg: Canary 12h check: no OOMs on replay, p99 mem within target. Continuing monitoring.
PM-Juno: Drafted customer note: mitigation applied, longer-term rewrite planned (link to epic). Will send once prod rollout confirmed.
SRE-bot: Production rollout scheduled at 2025-06-06T07:30Z pending 24h canary green.
Rae: Thanks team. Closing thread  hotfix in flight, UX quickwins staged, runtime rewrite parked as follow-on. :white_check_mark:
